models.mac.base module¶

Base class for classical machine learning models.

class models.mac.base.ClassicalModel(output_type='prediction')[source]¶

Bases: Module, ABC

Abstract base class for classical machine learning models. Wraps scikit-learn/XGBoost/LightGBM models to be used within NGLab.

Classification and Regression Tree (CART). Default sklearn behavior.

class models.mac.trees.CHAIDModel(task='regression', **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: DecisionTreeModel

Chi-squared Automatic Interaction Detection (CHAID). Uses Chi-square tests for splits. sklearn doesn’t support Chi-square splits natively. This is a placeholder wrapper that uses the standard DecisionTreeModel.

Bases: DecisionTreeModel

Conditional Decision Tree. Approximated by requiring a minimum impurity decrease for splits.
